recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Islamabad High Court** (IHC) issued a stay order on the Capital Development Authority's (CDA) eviction of residents from One Constitution Avenue, halting any coercive action against them. The court also directed the CDA not to take any further steps until the next hearing.  The dispute stems from a 2005 lease agreement between the **CDA** and BNP for a five-star hotel project that was later converted into residential apartments. Residents allege officials broke down their doors to serve eviction notices, while the **CDA** argues the company behind the project defaulted on payments. The court heard arguments from both sides, including claims of subleasing and financial obligations.
